description.value: Mossom Creek Hatchery and Education Centre is one of the longest-running community hatcheries in British Columbia, established in 1976 by high school volunteers and now managed by the Burrard Inlet Marine Enhancement Society within Mossom Creek Park in Port Moody. The facility sits in a pristine watershed setting with forest and creek views, wildlife cameras, and hands-on salmon enhancement and education programs. In 2023 it received the Gold Accessibility Certification from the Rick Hansen Foundation.

address.value: 12 Mossom Creek Drive, Port Moody, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for mossomcreek.org is the Mossom Creek Hatchery and Education Centre (BIMES), which operates within Mossom Creek Park in Port Moody, BC — not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states. The site is active with an upcoming 50th anniversary event and confirms the physical address as 12 Mossom Creek Drive, Port Moody. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the sparse OSM tags.

OSM name is 'Mossom Creek Park' (the nature reserve) while the URL resolves to the Mossom Creek Hatchery & Education Centre — a distinct operated entity within the park. These may warrant separate OSM records.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record is for the park/nature reserve, but the discovered URL leads to the hatchery and education centre operating within it — a legitimate and notable attraction for touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify amenities before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The facility holds Gold Accessibility Certification (Rick Hansen Foundation, May 2023). Facility rental is available including a covered patio and outdoor shelter, which may incidentally serve cyclists, but no cycling amenities are explicitly mentioned.
